titulo.alumno:
«Идти или ходить»
Walking: one trip or a habit

intro: Идти usually describes walking in one particular direction; ходить describes a habit, repetition or trips in different directions.

piezas.titulo: Идти usually describes walking in one particular direction; ходить describes a habit, repetition or trips in different directions.
texto: Идти usually describes walking in one particular direction; ходить describes a habit, repetition or trips in different directions.
With movement verbs, context decides whether the journey is happening now or a habitual route is being described.

frases.alumno: I am walking to the pharmacy now.

frases.estudio: Я хожу в эту аптеку по субботам.
frases.alumno: I go to this pharmacy on Saturdays.

pregunta.texto: Which verb fits «now, heading towards the pharmacy»?

opciones.explicacion: Иду presents a current journey in one direction.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Сейчас я иду в аптеку.»

opciones.texto: I am walking to the pharmacy now.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: I go to this pharmacy on Saturdays.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Я хожу в эту аптеку по субботам

piezas.traduccion: I go to this pharmacy on Saturdays.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
